description:
Kanna and her orphanage face an immediate crisis—the orphanage is about to go bankrupt within an hour because of a debt she took six months earlier. The money was borrowed from Bricardi, the infamous founder of the continent’s greatest waterworks company, a man rumored to kill without hesitation for business. With the children starving and nowhere else to turn, Kanna resolves to do whatever it takes to repay the debt—even if it means giving up the purity she has guarded for eighty years.
